definitions.gloss: to take out; to get out
definitions.explanation: To remove something from inside a container, bag, pocket, etc.
To retrieve or extract data, information, or specific elements from a larger whole.

examples.japanese: {鞄|かばん}から{本|ほん}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To take a book out of a bag.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}からお{金|かね}を{取|と}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took out money from my wallet.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{中|なか}から{古|ふる}い{写真|しゃしん}を{取|と}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took out old photos from inside the box.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}から{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{取|と}り{出|だ}して、コップに{注|そそ}いだ。
examples.english: I took out the milk from the refrigerator and poured it into a glass.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷物|にもつ}を{開|あ}けて、{必要|ひつよう}なものから{順番|じゅんばん}に{取|と}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I opened the moving boxes and took things out in order of necessity.

examples.japanese: データを{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
{必要|ひつよう}な{情報|じょうほう}だけを{取|と}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I extracted only the necessary information.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}のデータから{重要|じゅうよう}な{数字|すうじ}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す{作業|さぎょう}は{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: The task of extracting important figures from a large amount of data is difficult.

examples.japanese: このソフトを{使|つか}えば、{動画|どうが}から{音声|おんせい}だけを{取|と}り{出|だ}すことができる。
examples.english: If you use this software, you can extract just the audio from a video.

examples.japanese: {研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}たちは{長年|ながねん}の{実験|じっけん}データから{新|あたら}しい{法則|ほうそく}を{取|と}り{出|だ}すことに{成功|せいこう}した。
examples.english: The researchers succeeded in extracting a new law from years of experimental data.

notes:
{取|と}り{出|だ}す is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) formed from {取|と}る (to take) + {出|だ}す (to put out). It emphasizes the action of removing something from an enclosed space.

ASPECT (ている):
{取|と}り{出|だ}している indicates the ongoing action of taking something out, while {取|と}り{出|だ}した describes the completed action.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [container]から[object]を{取|と}り{出|だ}す — to take [object] out of [container]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {財布|さいふ}から{取|と}り{出|だ}す (take out from wallet)
- {鞄|かばん}から{取|と}り{出|だ}す (take out from bag)
- データを{取|と}り{出|だ}す (extract data)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出|だ}す: more general "to put out, to take out"
- {取|と}り{出|だ}す: emphasizes the extracting action from inside something
- {引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to pull out (with more force or from a drawer)
